subject: ARLO SEO — Weekly Pulse — 2026-11-13
html:
Weekly Pulse — Nov 13, 2026

~19 weeks since kickoff (2026-07-04). site_id 12704162. The SE Ranking MCP connector failed to connect this session (CONNECT_TIMEOUT after 30s, confirmed on 3 separate tool lookups) — no fresh rank/backlink/Domain Trust/AI-visibility pull was possible. Figures below are the last confirmed data point (2026-11-12), explicitly labeled, not a new read.

Leads proxy (GA4 conversions)

Pending. GA4 (G-CP22NBPLFP) is firing on the live site, but this sandbox has no outbound access to the GA4 reporting API, so conversions can't be pulled from here. A scheduled data Action (outside this sandbox) fills this number in later.

Ranking movement

Unavailable this session — SE Ranking connector down, see "Anything broken?" below. Table shows the last confirmed read (2026-11-12) for reference; "Now" could not be refreshed.

As of the last confirmed pull (2026-11-12, Google USA): all 22 tracked keywords sat at the not-ranked floor (avg position 100) for a 29th straight session — unchanged since tracking began 2026-08-01. Whether that held true today is unknown; the connector failure means this session cannot confirm or deny it.

Traffic vs last week

Unavailable — same SE Ranking connector failure blocks the domain-overview pull. As of the last confirmed read, SE Ranking's domain overview still showed no ranking keywords for askarlo.app in the US index, so there was no organic footprint to measure traffic from anyway.

Anything broken?

Yes — the SE Ranking MCP connector. It failed to connect this session (CONNECT_TIMEOUT after 30s), confirmed on repeated tool lookups, so no rank, backlink, Domain Trust, or AI Result Tracker data could be pulled fresh. This is the first time in the tracked history that this specific pull has failed outright, rather than simply returning flat/unconfigured numbers — worth a human check on the SE Ranking connector's auth/config if it doesn't recover on its own by the next session. Everything else is healthy: all 65 SEO Report Email runs since kickoff are green, 65/65 all-time (confirmed via GitHub Actions), including this week's two mid-week trust fixes (2026-11-09 pricing-schema fix, 2026-11-12 Solo-page connector-availability fix). catalog.ts re-checked directly in this repo: Meta (May 2026 ETA), Shopify (April 2026), Stripe (June 2026), HubSpot (July 2026), Mailchimp/MailerLite (Jul/Aug 2026) are all still coming_soon, every ETA already past due — unchanged, still human-gated, nothing new to ship against the FOCUS cluster.

Reading the week

Two real trust/accuracy fixes shipped mid-week outside this pulse: Monday closed a fabricated $19–$499 pricing schema that had been live since the AggregateOffer was wired in, and Thursday caught the Solo-business-owner page's own FAQPage JSON-LD telling buyers and AI answer engines that Meta/Shopify/Stripe/email were connectable today when all four are still gated in catalog.ts — both are the kind of structured-data trust bug that compounds the longer it sits uncaught. This pulse itself is the odd one out: for the first time since tracking began on 2026-08-01, the SE Ranking connector didn't answer at all, so there's no fresh signal on rank, backlinks, Domain Trust, or AI visibility to report — only the last confirmed snapshot (flat 0/22, 2 backlinks/1 refdomain, Domain Trust 6). That connector failure, not the numbers themselves, is this week's actionable item.
